answer.reason: The verses tell of Jacob building a house there, Gideon's dealings with its men, and its naming, so a line of events can be drawn.

clauses.english: was where Jacob built a house and made booths for his cattle, giving the place its name
clauses.quote: built him an house, and made booths for his cattle

clauses.english: refused bread to Gideon's weary men as he pursued Zebah and Zalmunna
clauses.quote: Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand

clauses.english: had its elders taught with thorns and briers by Gideon
clauses.quote: he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers

doubts: JDG 8:14-15 left out as part of the same event as the punishment of the men of Succoth.

1KI 7:46, 2CH 4:17 only locate the place and are already in the summary; PSA 60:6 and PSA 108:7 mention the valley of Succoth in a divine declaration, not an event; JOS 13:27 only lists it among the cities of Gad.
